import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from datetime import datetime

# Create DataFrame from provided data
data = {

    'MntWines': [635, 11, 426, 11, 173],
    'MntFruits': [88, 1, 49, 4, 43],
    'MntMeatProducts': [546, 6, 127, 20, 118],
    'MntFishProducts': [172, 2, 111, 10, 46],
    'MntSweetProducts': [88, 1, 21, 3, 27],
    'MntGoldProds': [88, 6, 42, 5, 15],
    'NumDealsPurchases': [3, 2, 1, 2, 5],
    'NumWebPurchases': [8, 1, 8, 2, 5],
    'NumCatalogPurchases': [10, 1, 2, 0, 3],
    'NumStorePurchases': [4, 2, 10, 4, 6],
    'NumWebVisitsMonth': [7, 5, 4, 6, 5],
    'AcceptedCmp3': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'AcceptedCmp4': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'AcceptedCmp5': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'AcceptedCmp1': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'AcceptedCmp2': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'Complain': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'Z_CostContact': [3, 3, 3, 3, 3],
    'Z_Revenue': [11, 11, 11, 11, 11],
    'Response': [1, 0, 0, 0, 0]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Convert date column to datetime
df['Dt_Customer'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Dt_Customer'], format='%d-%m-%Y')

# Calculate age from Year_Birth
current_year = datetime.now().year
df['Age'] = current_year - df['Year_Birth']

# Calculate total spending
spending_cols = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
df['Total_Spending'] = df[spending_cols].sum(axis=1)

# Calculate total purchases
purchase_cols = ['NumDealsPurchases', 'NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases']
df['Total_Purchases'] = df[purchase_cols].sum(axis=1)

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(20, 16))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 3, figsize=(20, 16))

# 1. Income distribution by Education
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='Education', y='Income', ax=axes[0, 0], palette='Set2')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Income Distribution by Education Level')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Education Level')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Income')
axes[0, 0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Total Spending vs Income
scatter = axes[0, 1].scatter(df['Income'], df['Total_Spending'], 
                             c=df['Age'], cmap='viridis', s=100, alpha=0.7)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Total Spending vs Income (Colored by Age)')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Income')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Total Spending')
plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=axes[0, 1], label='Age')

# 3. Age distribution
axes[0, 2].hist(df['Age'], bins=15, edgecolor='black', color='skyblue', alpha=0.7)
axes[0, 2].set_title('Age Distribution')
axes[0, 2].set_xlabel('Age')
axes[0, 2].set_ylabel('Frequency')

# 4. Marital Status distribution
marital_counts = df['Marital_Status'].value_counts()
axes[1, 0].pie(marital_counts.values, labels=marital_counts.index, 
               autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=sns.color_palette('Set3'))
axes[1, 0].set_title('Marital Status Distribution')

# 5. Spending categories breakdown
spending_data = df[spending_cols].mean()
axes[1, 1].bar(spending_data.index, spending_data.values, color='lightcoral')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Average Spending by Product Category')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Product Category')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Average Spending')
axes[1, 1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 6. Purchase channels comparison
purchase_data = df[purchase_cols].mean()
axes[1, 2].bar(purchase_data.index, purchase_data.values, color='lightgreen')
axes[1, 2].set_title('Average Purchases by Channel')
axes[1, 2].set_xlabel('Purchase Channel')
axes[1, 2].set_ylabel('Average Number of Purchases')
axes[1, 2].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 7. Recency distribution
axes[2, 0].hist(df['Recency'], bins=10, edgecolor='black', color='gold', alpha=0.7)
axes[2, 0].set_title('Recency Distribution (Days since last purchase)')
axes[2, 0].set_xlabel('Recency (days)')
axes[2, 0].set_ylabel('Frequency')

# 8. Family composition
df['Total_Kids'] = df['Kidhome'] + df['Teenhome']
family_counts = df['Total_Kids'].value_counts().sort_index()
axes[2, 1].bar(family_counts.index, family_counts.values, color='lightblue')
axes[2, 1].set_title('Family Composition (Number of Children)')
axes[2, 1].set_xlabel('Number of Children')
axes[2, 1].set_ylabel('Count')

# 9. Customer enrollment timeline
df_sorted = df.sort_values('Dt_Customer')
axes[2, 2].plot(df_sorted['Dt_Customer'], df_sorted['Total_Spending'], 
                marker='o', linestyle='-', color='purple')
axes[2, 2].set_title('Customer Enrollment Timeline vs Total Spending')
axes[2, 2].set_xlabel('Enrollment Date')
axes[2, 2].set_ylabel('Total Spending')
axes[2, 2].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
